Parasol Stars - Rainbow Islands II.name: Parasol Stars: Rainbow Islands II
Parasol Stars - Rainbow Islands II.summary: A Port of "Parasol Stars: Rainbow Islands II" (also known as Bubble Bobble 3) was published by Ocean for the Game Boy in 1992.

Super Momotarou Dentetsu II.name: Super Momotaro Dentetsu II
Super Momotarou Dentetsu II.summary: Super Momotaro Dentetsu II is a Miscellaneous game, developed by Make and published by Hudson, which was released in Japan in 1992.
